capabilities: Sync Markdown flashcards to Anki decks via AnkiConnect (current note, whole vault, or on save)
Author cloze, Q/A, single/multiple-choice, and code-practice cards in plain Markdown
Create and edit image occlusion masks with an interactive editor and reveal order
Preserve stable file and card IDs so later syncs update existing notes without resetting review history
Control decks, tags, and exclusions per note through frontmatter
extras: Desktop-only plugin: Anki Desktop must be running locally. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README describes manual installation from GitHub Releases before directory inclusion. No telemetry; sync goes only to the configured (default local) AnkiConnect URL.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note content into Anki flashcards or keep those cards updated when the notes change.

relations.evidence: Anki Flashcard Sync sends flashcards written in your Markdown notes to Anki through AnkiConnect.

requires.name: Anki Desktop with the AnkiConnect add-on (code 2055492159) running; Obsidian Desktop 1.5.7+

summary: Syncs cloze, Q/A, multiple-choice, code-practice, and image occlusion flashcards from Markdown notes to Anki over AnkiConnect, with stable IDs for updates.
